title: COVID-19 (Coronavirus Disease)
subtitle: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, first identified in Wuhan, China in late 2019.

sections.title: Symptoms
sections.intro: COVID-19 symptoms range from mild to severe. Most people experience mild to moderate illness and recover without special treatment. Older adults and those with underlying conditions are at greater risk of serious illness.

sections.title: Causes
sections.intro: COVID-19 is caused by SARS-CoV-2, a novel coronavirus. The virus has spike proteins on its surface that attach to ACE2 receptors found in the lungs, heart, kidneys, and other organs.
items: SARS-CoV-2 virus belonging to the Coronaviridae family
Variants including Alpha, Delta, Omicron, and subvariants
Zoonotic origin, believed to have jumped from animals to humans
Mutations continue to produce new variants with different characteristics

sections.title: Transmission
sections.intro: COVID-19 spreads primarily through respiratory droplets and aerosols when an infected person breathes, coughs, sneezes, talks, or sings. Close contact is the main route of transmission.
items: Respiratory droplets from coughs and sneezes
Airborne aerosols in poorly ventilated spaces
Close personal contact (within 1 metre)
Touching contaminated surfaces then touching face
Asymptomatic and pre-symptomatic spread is common
Highest risk in enclosed, crowded, poorly ventilated areas

sections.title: Prevention
sections.intro: Vaccination remains the most effective protection against severe COVID-19. Combining vaccination with good hygiene and ventilation provides the best defense.
items: Get vaccinated and stay up to date with boosters
Wear a well-fitting mask in crowded indoor settings
Wash hands frequently with soap for 20 seconds
Improve ventilation, open windows, use air purifiers
Maintain distance from people who are ill
Avoid touching eyes, nose, and mouth

sections.title: Treatment
sections.intro: Most people with COVID-19 recover at home with rest and symptom management. Severe cases may require hospitalization and advanced medical care.
items: Rest and stay hydrated, most mild cases resolve in 1, 2 weeks
Antivirals (e.g. Paxlovid/nirmatrelvir) for high risk patients
Fever reducers like paracetamol or ibuprofen
Oxygen therapy for cases with low blood oxygen
Mechanical ventilation in critical cases
Isolation to prevent spreading to others

sections.title: Diagnosis
sections.intro: COVID-19 can be diagnosed with several types of tests. Early testing helps with treatment decisions and prevents spread to others.
items: PCR test (Polymerase Chain Reaction), most accurate, detects viral RNA
Rapid Antigen Test, quick home-use test, results in 15, 30 minutes
Antibody test, detects past infection, not for active diagnosis
CT scan or chest X-ray may be used for severe respiratory cases
